newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-QCT signs US$370 mln debt facility.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-QCT signs US$370 mln debt facility.

text.p: Coking coal miner and exporter QCT Resources Ltd said on Friday that it has signed a revolving credit facility with an initial term of five years for an amount of US$370 million.
QCT said utilisation of the new facilities would lead to a reduction in the costs of the group's borrowings.
It was intended that borrowings under the new facilities would be used to repay amounts currently drawn under the previous facilities as those amounts fell due, QCT said.

It said the Kenmare underground mine in Queensland started longwall productions on November 13. Total longwall productions had now reached 120,000 tonnes of raw coal, with daily output regularly exceeding 9,000 tonnes per day.
Average output rates were expected to rise a further 50 percent as the commissioning process neared completion.
At 12.25 p.m. (0125 GMT), QCT shares were three cents up at A$1.59.
